question: How should the yogi practice mantra to accomplish tattva-unity?
premises: The yogi should take refuge in the root mantra alone.
The practice should be carried on reverently up to the nonconceptual end.
Through mantra practice one may accomplish either enjoyment or liberation.
inference: Disciplined root-mantra practice culminating in the nonconceptual state can yield either worldly enjoyment or liberation.
uncertainties: The identity of the 'root mantra' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The yogi should rely on the root mantra alone, practicing it with reverence all the way to the nonconceptual state. Through that mantra practice, he may accomplish either enjoyment or liberation.
